articles.title: Swedish flea-market Buddha bought for SEK 20 sells for SEK 2.44M after 40 years
articles.summary: A small Buddha statue purchased for over SEK 20 at a Uppsala flea market turned out to be a rare artifact from the Ming dynasty's Yongle period. After resting in obscurity for years, it astonishingly sold for SEK 2,437,500 at auction.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Pralay: Kalyani Priyadarshan shifts to Mumbai, trains for Ranveer Singh starrer
articles.summary: Kalyani Priyadarshan, who has always called Chennai and Kochi home, has made Mumbai her base for much of this year as she gears up for her Hindi film debut in 'Pralay' opposite Ranveer Singh. As per mid-day, the actor has rented an apartment in Juhu to focus entirely on the zombie thriller, undergoing rigorous action training and a specialised diet ahead of the film's next shooting schedule later this year..

articles.title: Shanoo post sparks debate: Casting director’s ‘talent’ note divides actors
articles.summary: Casting director Shanoo Sharma's Instagram post, "I hope the next big trend is talent," has sparked speculation, coming days after Anjali Anand claimed Sharma once told her to lose weight. Bhumi Pednekar and Ridhima Pandit reacted, with Pandit arguing connections and visibility matter more in Bollywood, fuelling a wider online debate..

articles.title: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan tells paps to get together for a group photo
articles.summary: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan made a stunning return from Paris Fashion Week, flaunting her vibrant new burgundy locks. Excited fans and paparazzi were treated to her warm interactions as she signed autographs, even taking a moment to gather for a cheerful group photo.

articles.title: Rajinikanth surprises fans by arriving at ‘Dharmam’ shoot in an auto-rickshaw
articles.summary: Rajinikanth has successfully wrapped up filming in Mysuru for his highly anticipated project 'Dharmam', directed by Ashwath Marimuthu. Videos capturing the superstar arriving via auto-rickshaw have made waves across social media, with fans flocking to show their support.
